| 1 | 2026-11-02 |  | Should the step list live in nested frontmatter YAML or in a body table? | wiki/decisions/DEC-0921.md; wiki/issues/WK-0923.md; wiki/initiatives/IN-0921.md; this record's own Open Questions | DEC-0921 (accepted, 2026-08-30) already settles this exact question: structured lists go in a body table, never nested frontmatter; no record type in this repo uses nested frontmatter YAML anywhere; a comparable structured list already lives in a body table (wiki/plans/PLN-0001/execution/tracker.md); WK-0923 documents the frontmatter parser flattening nested YAML keys, though that ticket is still open/unreproduced so this piece of the rationale is an asserted gap, not a demonstrated one — no parser code exists yet in this repo either way | nested frontmatter YAML; body table | body table | DEC-0921 is an accepted decision directly on point; overturning it would need a new decision, not a one-off pick on WK-0921. Cold check found no nested-YAML precedent and a body-table precedent, so the choice holds even though the parser-gap half of DEC-0921's rationale rests on an unreproduced bug ticket | pass |
